meta.title: Features - Beamlynx
meta.description: What Beamlynx can do: joins from your schema, paths between tables, safe AI agents, access policies, edits across joins, and more.

heading: What Beamlynx can do
lede: Beamlynx reads your schema, so much of what you would normally write by hand, it offers you instead. Here is what that adds up to.

joins.title: Joins come from your schema
joins.body: Pick a table, and Beamlynx lists every table it connects to: the ones that point at it, and the ones it points at. When two foreign keys lead to the same table, it shows which column each one uses.

paths.title: Find the way between two tables
paths.body: Name the table you want to reach, and Beamlynx finds every chain of joins that gets there, including routes through tables you hadn't thought of. Pick a route, and it's added in one step.

traverse.title: See everything that depends on a row
traverse.body: Traverse follows every table that points at the current one, up to 25 levels deep. It counts the rows in each. It can also write a delete script that removes them, deepest table first, for you to copy or run.

edit.title: Edit results, even across joins
edit.body: Change a value right in the results, even when the result joins several tables. Beamlynx keeps each table's id with the result, so the change reaches the right row. A value that can't be changed says why.

agents.title: AI agents that can look, not touch
agents.body: Beamlynx has a built-in MCP server, so an AI agent such as Claude Code can query the databases you allow. It can only read: every update and delete is refused. It never sees or writes SQL, and every query it runs shows up in Beamlynx.

access.title: Hide what shouldn't be seen
access.body: An access policy masks columns as xxxxx inside the database query, so the real value never leaves the database. Set a policy per connection, and choose whether it applies only to AI agents or to you as well. An agent that needs a masked column has to ask, and you approve or decline.

sql.title: The SQL is always there
sql.body: Every query's SQL is one click away, to read or to copy. When you'd rather write SQL yourself, switch the panel to SQL and run it as it is.

keyboard.title: Works without a mouse
keyboard.body: Ctrl+Shift+P opens the command palette. On the canvas, single keys do the work: i joins, w filters, s selects, p finds a path, and j and k move between tables. The editor has a Vim mode.

grid.title: A results grid that keeps up
grid.body: The grid draws only the rows on screen, so even 100,000 rows scroll smoothly. Select a range with the keyboard or the mouse and paste it straight into a spreadsheet, or download the whole result as CSV.

drawingsNote: The pictures on this page are simplified drawings of the app. The names and values in them come from a sample shop database.
